title: Export scoped shipment and finance amount summaries to PDF
description: A sales user downloads the monetary summary shown by the shipment/finance report designer in the existing paged Chinese PDF for the current authorized order page. Reuse ERP-162 finite SummaryMode and summary DTOs in ERP-156 bounded preview; append a separate current-page amount-summary section for supported non-none modes while preserving existing selected-column pages for none. Recheck current-user sales-order menu and SalespersonDataScopeService scope on each export, reject invalid modes before source reads, retain OperationLogMiddleware audit and explicit missing-SimHei failure. Keep customer, original currency and optional shipment/finance status boundaries; null linked/uncovered/submitted evidence remains unknown with known/unknown row counts, and uncovered amount is not an AR balance. Development only: no arbitrary SQL, schema/migrations, production SQL or real database execution, business writes, secrets/.env changes, deployment or browser acceptance. Verify focused PDF tests and safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: PDF export reuses the ERP-162 authorized bounded current page and finite SummaryMode validation; none retains the existing selected-column document.

Supported modes append a separately titled current-page summary section keyed by customer, original currency and optional status, with known/unknown counts, explicit unknown and empty text, readable page bounds and visible missing-SimHei failure; no cross-currency or AR totals.

PDF tests cover all modes, denial, invalid mode, multiple currencies, null evidence, empty/paged results, long labels, pagination, font failure and original document preservation; document download scope and pass safe Release build/test.
